name: Breoga

attributes.attribute: a Partholonian who helped civilize his people
settled disputes in a single fight

text: Breoga appears in the Book of Invasions as a Partholonian. He worked to civilize his people. Breoga asked those who disagreed to settle their quarrels by dueling instead of marching to battle. This single combat joined the dispute and spared the tribe from wider war.

okr.objective: Describe Breoga, a Partholonian of the Book of Invasions.
key_results: He had disputants settle quarrels in single combat.
His way avoided going to war.
